messages:
Priya Nair: Hey everyone, just setting up my desk and noticed the USB-C to Ethernet dongle is missing from my box. Monitor, stand, and dock are present though.
it-support-bot: Sorry about that, Priya. Created ticket IT-4907 and notified Delivery Ops. Can you confirm the kit SKU printed on the packing slip?
Priya Nair: Packing slip SKU reads RDW-KIT-V2. No photo — I tossed the outer cardboard but still have the slip.
Delivery Ops: Thanks for the heads up. We've flagged the outbound pack for audit. Priya, replacement dongle request submitted, expedited label added. Tracking will be posted here in ~2 hours.
Priya Nair: Appreciate it. Do I need to return anything from the kit?
it-support-bot: No return required for missing accessories. If you find any foam inserts or loose parts, keep them for 48 hours in case shipping requests a photo.
Tom Rivera: Welcome Priya! Quick tip: if you need temporary access, the dock should support tethered Wi-Fi via phone hotspot. If you want, I can swing by with a spare dongle from the office stash later today.
Priya Nair: That would be amazing, thanks Tom — I'm at desk D12 in SF office.
Delivery Ops: Replacement sent, tracking: 1Z999AA10123456784. ETA 2 business days. Ref SHIP-99555.
Priya Nair: Got the tracking, thanks. Will update here once it arrives and works.
it-support-bot: Reminder: please run 'ifconfig' after plugging in and post output snippet if you hit connectivity issues.
Priya Nair: Follow-up: quick question — who owns the monitor cable inventory? Mine had a different length HDMI than expected and it's tugging awkwardly.
Tom Rivera: That's Facilities for cable replacements; filing a Facilities request now and adding you as requester.
Priya Nair: Thanks team! Feeling supported already :heart:
